parent_actions_required: Freeze actual candidate full bytes after filling template with authoritative source/build/tool/binary bindings and persistent canonical paths.
Independent admission binds full candidate SHA, binary descriptor and frozen_inputs SHA. Outer wrapper binds candidate+admission descriptors; supply independently expected wrapper SHA on CLI.
Run validate-only CLI before the separately authorized native invocation; root controls launch.
Any pre-data source correction changes tool manifest and requires appropriate pure tests and concrete admission update.
source_guards_scope: Selected actual sources, not a hermetic compiler closure. Frozen runtime modules listed in manifest; no future xtask/report pointer demanded unchanged forever.
failure_policy: stop_on_first_failure_no_resume_or_replacement; all six durable claims exist before first launch, remaining unlaunched claims retained
reader_limits: 16MiB stored/32MiB raw per whole single gzip member, fixed header, complete EOF/CRC, source schema/count/word/identity, all six original process exits and artifacts, exact captured checkpoint equality and fresh ON completed-record bytes. Arithmetic exclusion/mismatch/failed or partial collection are non-PASS; private caches, runtime modes, convergence/SI accuracy/coupled-cause excluded.
